token_budget_basis.node_purpose: Resolve only the material-scope ambiguity that deterministic request compilation cannot classify, without performing retrieval or research judgment.
token_budget_basis.input_scale: At most twelve compiled EvidenceRequests; each exposes one facet, up to six metric intents, up to four product intents, required material roles and requested fiscal years.
required_outputs: one disposition for every request-visible product intent
complete coverage of every required material role
bounded request-visible metric and hard-product index combinations
explicit temporal and collective coverage modes
token_budget_basis.schema_burden: Exact JSON with request IDs, integer indices and closed enums only; the Harness derives identity, dates, sources, requirement IDs, target entities and capacity.
token_budget_basis.materiality_and_quality_risk: A long research topic can otherwise be mistaken for one literal product, silently discarded as context, or expanded into invented aliases that make material coverage appear complete.
token_budget_basis.comparable_run_evidence: The zero-call four-case replay found MU 4/4 and NVDA 6/6 scope-ready, but COST 3/5 and DELL 3/3 composite requests require explicit natural scope before product use; aggregate runtime-scope readiness is COST 2/5 and DELL 0/3.
token_budget_basis.reasoning_profile: Bounded classification and decomposition; no candidate review, source search, financial fact inference or report writing.
token_budget_basis.stop_and_truncation: Fail closed on missing request, product disposition, required role, metric coverage, hard-product coverage, invalid temporal pairing or output truncation; never infer omitted atoms locally.

known_boundary: This node only translates a request-visible composite theme into material requirements. It does not find sources, rank candidates, promote Evidence, create NumericFact or judge whether an Evidence Pack is research-ready.
